title: [Master]-CH] SEPA XML Files should append the Address 1 + '' + Address 2 fields under <PstlAdr><StrtNm> node if we use "Address 2" as Building Number for QR-Bills
summary: SEPA XML exports for Swiss QR-Bills now combine Address 1 and Address 2 fields in the street name node when Address 2 is used as a building number.
key_points: SEPA XML export functionality updated for Swiss payments
Address 1 and Address 2 are concatenated in the <PstlAdr><StrtNm> node
Applies specifically to QR-Bill payment processing
Test coverage added for the new address concatenation behavior
Affects Payment Export Data table structure
